question: How does the value of other practices compare to the recitation-sacrifice?
premises: All those others are compared to the recitation-sacrifice.
They do not merit even a sixteenth part of it.
inference: The recitation-sacrifice vastly surpasses all other practices.
uncertainties: The sequence nārhanti arhanti may be emphatic or a textual irregularity.
plain_english: All of them do not deserve even a sixteenth part of the sacrifice of recitation.
